name: Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following — USD/JPY
description: Trend-following strategy on USD/JPY using Ichimoku Kinko Hyo on daily bars. Long when price is above the cloud, Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen, AND Chikou span is above the cloud (shifted back 26 bars). Short when price is below the cloud, Tenkan crosses below Kijun, AND Chikou span is below the cloud. Exits on TK cross reversal or price re-entering the cloud. Risk-based position sizing: 2% equity risk per trade with 3x ATR(14) stop distance. Standard Ichimoku parameters: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52.
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Trend-Following Strategy — USD/JPY
# Entry: Price above/below cloud AND TK cross in direction AND Chikou span confirms
# Exit: TK cross reversal OR price drops/rises into cloud
# Sizing: 2% equity risk, 3x ATR(14) stop distance
# Parameters: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# --- Ichimoku Cloud (standard parameters) ---
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(high, low, close)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# --- Cloud Boundaries ---
# Price above cloud: above BOTH Senkou Span A and B
cloud_top = where(senkou_a > senkou_b, senkou_a, senkou_b)
cloud_bottom = where(senkou_a > senkou_b, senkou_b, senkou_a)

above_cloud = close > cloud_top
below_cloud = close < cloud_bottom

# --- Chikou Span Confirmation (close shifted back 26 bars vs cloud at that point) ---
chikou = close >> 26
chikou_senkou_a = senkou_a >> 26
chikou_senkou_b = senkou_b >> 26
chikou_cloud_top = where(chikou_senkou_a > chikou_senkou_b, chikou_senkou_a, chikou_senkou_b)
chikou_cloud_bottom = where(chikou_senkou_a > chikou_senkou_b, chikou_senkou_b, chikou_senkou_a)
chikou_above_cloud = chikou > chikou_cloud_top
chikou_below_cloud = chikou < chikou_cloud_bottom

# --- TK Cross Signals ---
tk_cross_bull = crossover(tenkan, kijun)    # Tenkan crosses above Kijun
tk_cross_bear = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)   # Tenkan crosses below Kijun

# --- Entry Signals ---
# Long: TK bullish cross + price above cloud + Chikou span above cloud
# Short: TK bearish cross + price below cloud + Chikou span below cloud
# Use hold_until to persist the cross state so it can combine with filters
long_cross_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bull, exit=tk_cross_bear)
short_cross_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bear, exit=tk_cross_bull)

long_entry = long_cross_state and above_cloud and chikou_above_cloud
short_entry = short_cross_state and below_cloud and chikou_below_cloud

# --- Exit Conditions ---
# Exit long: TK bearish cross OR price drops below cloud bottom
# Exit short: TK bullish cross OR price rises above cloud top
long_exit = tk_cross_bear or (close < cloud_bottom)
short_exit = tk_cross_bull or (close > cloud_top)

# Held signal: long from entry until exit, short from entry until exit
held_long = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=long_exit)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=short_exit)

# --- ATR for Stop Distance ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Risk-based sizing: 2% equity risk, stop at 2x ATR from entry
# Risk-based sizing: 2% equity risk, stop at 3x ATR from entry
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price, rr_ratio=2.0)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=atr_val * 3)
